// diagnostic

L0528

This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused

What

This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused

Why

The binding is marked mutable but receives no later write.

Fix

Declare it with `::` instead of `:=`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0528: tests/ui_lint/busy_spin.warn.

Warning [jet.SharedBusyWait]: This unbounded loop polls `Shared` state without waiting
  --> tests/ui_lint/busy_spin.jet:6:15
    |
  6 |     loop flag.ready == false {}
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: An empty or non-blocking body reads a lock-backed value repeatedly and can consume a core while another task makes progress
 Fix: Wait on a `Condition` through an edit guard, or receive from a channel; an empty plain-field predicate can use that wait directly
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0207

Warning [jet.MutableNeverReassigned]: This mutable binding receives no later write, so its mutability is unused
  --> tests/ui_lint/busy_spin.jet:45:5
    |
 45 |     flag := shared Flag{ ready: true, ticks: 0 }
    |     ^^^^
 Why: The binding is marked mutable but receives no later write.
 Fix: Declare it with `::` instead of `:=`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0528
